## Project Overview

**Project Name:**  
(e.g., Caribbean Open Data Initiative)

**Short Summary:**  
_Give a brief (1-2 sentence) summary of the project’s aims._

## Problem Statement & Scope

**What specific problem or gap does this project address?**  
_Describe the challenge/opportunity and why it matters for the Caribbean digital ecosystem._

**Who are the known stakeholders/beneficiaries?**  
_List individuals, organizations, countries, or communities that will benefit from this project._

## Proposed Solution

**Describe your proposed solution.**  
_Include key components, expected outputs, and delivery approach._

**Technical Requirements & Prerequisites:**  
_Give a summary of the core infrastructure, software, standards, or partnerships required._

## Strategic Fit

**How does this project align with Consortium goals and regional priorities?**  
_Reference relevant priorities (e.g. sovereignty, innovation, interoperability, public good)._

## Governance & Sustainability

**Suggested project stewards/governing body:**  
_If you have recommendations for who should steward this project, note them here._

**Does the project model address sustainability (e.g., funding, ongoing maintenance)?**  
_Y/N; please describe if yes._

## Commercialization & Community Impact

**Is there an intended commercialization plan or pathway?**  
_Describe possibilities such as open source, managed services, licensing, or regional adoption._

**Anticipated community/regional impact:**  
_Highlight positive social, economic, or technological outcomes._

## Incubation & Next Steps

**Are you requesting incubation support from the Consortium?**  
_Y/N; specify required support: mentorship, technical reviews, funding, pilots, etc._

**Initial milestones or timeline:**  
_Identify key phases, deliverables, or dates for project progression._

## Additional Information

**Links, resources, or references:**  
_Add any helpful links (docs, research, similar projects)_

---

_Once submitted, Consortium members and community can provide feedback, request clarifications, and initiate vetting per governance guidelines._
